GTA 6's 8 Game Awards Nominations: Our Honest Odds
description: GTA 6 is up for 8 awards at The Game Awards 2026, the most of any game: Game of the Year, Best Game Direction, Best Narrative, Best Art Direction, Best Score and Music, Best Audio Design, Best Performance (Manni L. Perez as Lucia) and Best Action/Adventure. Every category, every rival, and our honest odds (our prediction: 6 of 8). The show is Thursday, December 10, 7:30 PM ET, live from the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles; winners are picked 90% by a jury and 10% by fans. Even a clean sweep can't beat Clair Obscur's record of 9 wins in one night (2025); 8 would be the 2nd most ever, ahead of The Last of Us Part II's 7 (2020). No story spoilers.

segments.headline: GTA 6 VS THE AWARDS
segments.text: GTA 6 is up for eight Game Awards, the most of any game this year. Here's every category, who it's up against, and our honest odds.

segments.headline: DECEMBER 10
segments.text: The show is Thursday, December tenth, at seven thirty Eastern, live from Los Angeles. Winners are picked ninety percent by a jury and ten percent by fans.

chart.ticker: free on YouTube, Twitch and Disney+ · jury 90% + fan vote 10%

segments.headline: 8 NOMINATIONS
segments.text: And a fun fact: the nominations came out on November seventeenth. GTA 6 launched on the nineteenth. It was up for Game of the Year two days before it even came out.

segments.headline: GAME OF THE YEAR
segments.text: Category one, Game of the Year. GTA 6 is up against 007 First Light, Control Resonant, Phantom Blade Zero, Resident Evil Requiem and the Ocarina of Time remake.

chart.ticker: 007 First Light · Control Resonant · Phantom Blade Zero · Resident Evil Requiem · Zelda: Ocarina of Time

segments.headline: THE FAVORITE
segments.text: Our call: it's the favorite. Ninety nine on Metacritic, a hundred eighteen perfect scores, and more nominations than anything else.

segments.headline: GAME DIRECTION
segments.text: Two, Best Game Direction, against Control Resonant, Phantom Blade Zero, Pragmata and Resident Evil Requiem. This is the award for making everything work together. We think GTA 6 takes it.

chart.ticker: Control Resonant · Phantom Blade Zero · Pragmata · Resident Evil Requiem

segments.headline: NARRATIVE
segments.text: Three, Best Narrative, against 007 First Light, Control Resonant, Resident Evil Requiem and The Blood of Dawnwalker. This is our first coin flip.

chart.ticker: 007 First Light · Control Resonant · Resident Evil Requiem · The Blood of Dawnwalker

segments.headline: ART DIRECTION
segments.text: Four, Best Art Direction, against Control Resonant, Mouse P.I. For Hire, Phantom Blade Zero and Ocarina of Time. A whole state built to look like Florida, down to the swamps. We call it a lock.

chart.ticker: Control Resonant · Mouse: P.I. For Hire · Phantom Blade Zero · Zelda: Ocarina of Time

segments.headline: SCORE AND MUSIC
segments.text: Five, Best Score and Music, against Ace Combat 8, Mixtape, Phantom Blade Zero and Ocarina of Time. Mixtape is a game built around its soundtrack, so this one is real competition.

chart.ticker: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve · Mixtape · Phantom Blade Zero · Zelda: Ocarina of Time

segments.headline: AUDIO DESIGN
segments.text: Six, Best Audio Design, against Ace Combat 8, Control Resonant, Resident Evil Requiem and Star Wars Galactic Racer. A city this loud and this detailed is GTA's home turf. Likely win.

chart.ticker: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve · Control Resonant · Resident Evil Requiem · Star Wars: Galactic Racer

segments.headline: PERFORMANCE
segments.text: Seven, Best Performance. Manni L. Perez is nominated for Lucia. Fun fact: this list is how most fans learned who plays her, because Rockstar never announced it.

chart.ticker: Rockstar never announced her: the nominee list did · IBTimes · Exputer

segments.headline: THE RIVALS
segments.text: Her competition: Patrick Gibson from 007 First Light, Angela Sant'Albano from Resident Evil Requiem, Liam McIntyre from Marvel's Wolverine and Rahul Kohli from Saros. Coin flip number two.

chart.ticker: Patrick Gibson (007 First Light) · Angela Sant'Albano (Resident Evil Requiem) · Liam McIntyre (Marvel's Wolverine) · Rahul Kohli (Saros)

segments.headline: ACTION/ADVENTURE
segments.text: Eight, Best Action Adventure, against 007 First Light, Control Resonant, Pragmata, Resident Evil Requiem and Ocarina of Time. Likely win.

chart.ticker: 007 First Light · Control Resonant · Pragmata · Resident Evil Requiem · Zelda: Ocarina of Time

segments.headline: THE RECORD
segments.text: Now the record. Clair Obscur won nine awards in one night last year. GTA 6 is only up for eight, so even a clean sweep can't beat it.

segments.headline: 2ND ALL TIME
segments.text: But eight would still put it second all time, ahead of the seven The Last of Us Part Two won in twenty twenty.

chart.ticker: Clair Obscur 9 (2025) · The Last of Us Part II 7 (2020)

segments.headline: OUR ODDS
segments.text: Our full call: Game of the Year and Art Direction are locks. Direction, Audio, Action Adventure and Score are likely. Narrative and Performance are coin flips.

chart.title: OUR ODDS: S LOCK · A LIKELY · B COIN FLIP

segments.headline: 6 OF 8
segments.text: Our final number: six out of eight. Results are Thursday night, and we'll break down every win and loss right after.

segments.headline: YOUR NUMBER?
segments.text: How many do you think it wins? Drop your number in the comments, and subscribe: we cover GTA 6 every day.
